# Lyrenza Vancouver Coal Harbour

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Vancouver Coal Harbour is in Vancouver, Canada, in the North America region.
Facilities: Saltwater pool; spa; bicycle program; mountain-view lounge. Pool or water-facility hours: 06:00-22:00.
Parking: Valet parking; CAD 48 nightly. Transportation: Waterfront rail station is a ten-minute walk.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
